page_title: AST 4-2 LIV | Aston Villa v Liverpool 15/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will deliver the corner kick.
90+7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
90+6' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90+5' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+4' Referee Chris Kavanagh sees the trip by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Aston Villa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

90+2' 4 - 2 Dominik Szoboszlai sends a superb cross into the box. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the right post, leaving Emiliano Martinez beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 4:2.
90+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Youri Tielemans walks off the pitch and Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) comes on as a substitute.
90' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) replacing John McGinn.

89' 4 - 1 Ollie Watkins passes to John McGinn (Aston Villa), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the top left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 4:1.
87' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
85' Emiliano Buendia has picked up an injury and is replaced by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa).
85' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle.
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
83' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
82' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
81' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
79' The resulting corner from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) comes to nothing.
78' The ball is cleared after Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
77' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
75' Referee Chris Kavanagh points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Aston Villa players.
74' Substitution. Cody Gakpo is replaced by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool).
74' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Aston Villa players aren’t happy.
73' 3 - 1 Goal! 3:1. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
73' A tremendous drive by Pau Torres (Aston Villa) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a brilliant save.
73' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is about to take a corner kick.
72' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
71' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
70' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.

68' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
67' The attendance is 43033.
66' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) replaces Ryan Gravenberch.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Joe Gomez will be replaced by Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
66' The foul by John McGinn (Aston Villa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.

65' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Giorgi Mamardashvili was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
64' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
62' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Joe Gomez (Liverpool), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
60' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.

57' 2 - 1 Goal! Morgan Rogers produces a great pass that finds Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
57' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
55' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' 1 - 1 The ball is whipped in from the free kick and finds the head of Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool), who rises and produces an amazing header inside the right post.
51' Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) commits a rough foul. Chris Kavanagh stops the game and makes a call.
48' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) comes on the pitch for Victor Lindelof.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The game is interrupted. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45+1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) jumps into a tackle and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.

42' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Digne manages to prod the ball to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
42' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) prepares to take a corner kick.
41' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
39' Chris Kavanagh shows the yellow card to Matty Cash (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
38' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
37' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
34' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
33' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
32' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

32' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Emiliano Martinez! Liverpool earn a corner.
30' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
27' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

25' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
23' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

21' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
20' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
14' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
13' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

12' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul.
12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
11' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
10' The game is interrupted now, Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

9' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
8' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' The game is interrupted. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
2' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Giorgi Mamardashvili.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Liverpool will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
